text.tspan: Step 1 · recover secret byte 0 — send 15 filler bytes

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: TARGET · encrypt these 16 bytes, keep ciphertext block 0

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: PROBE · try candidate = 0..255 in the last slot — block matches when ? = S0

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: ▼ shift the filler down by one byte

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Step 2 · recover secret byte 1 — send 14 filler bytes

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: TARGET · S0 is already known from step 1

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: PROBE · match now reveals S1 — then shift and repeat for every byte

text.tspan: Full secret recovered without ever holding the key
≤ 256 × L oracle queries for an L-byte secret — about 128 × L on average
